config.label: Set to 'stdio' for desktop AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor)
config.description: Set to 'stdio' for desktop AI clients (Claude Desktop, Cursor). Defaults to 'http'.

config.label: Which warehouse to connect to
config.description: Which warehouse to connect to. One of: postgres, oracle, redshift, snowflake, bigquery, duckdb. (DuckDB also handles MotherDuck via DUCKDB_PATH=md:<db>.)

config.label: Comma-separated bearer keys with role and optional warehouse-role impersonation: 'key1:reader,key2:admin', 'key3:reader:set_role=alice'
config.description: Comma-separated bearer keys with role and optional warehouse-role impersonation: 'key1:reader,key2:admin', 'key3:reader:set_role=alice'. Leave empty for stdio (OS process boundary is the trust boundary). Required for HTTP.

config.label: DuckDB file path, ':memory:', or 'md:<database>' for MotherDuck
config.description: DuckDB file path, ':memory:', or 'md:<database>' for MotherDuck. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=duckdb.

config.label: MotherDuck service token
config.description: MotherDuck service token. Required when DUCKDB_PATH starts with 'md:'.

config.label: Postgres host
config.description: Postgres host. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=postgres. (Use REDSHIFT_HOST for Redshift.)

config.label: Oracle Easy Connect (e
config.description: Oracle Easy Connect (e.g. host:1521/SERVICE), TNS descriptor, or alias.

config.label: Snowflake account identifier (e
config.description: Snowflake account identifier (e.g. xy12345.us-east-1). Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=snowflake.

config.label: Path to PKCS8 private key (
config.description: Path to PKCS8 private key (.p8). Snowflake auth is key-pair only; password auth is not supported.

config.label: GCP project id
config.description: GCP project id. Required when WAREHOUSE_TYPE=bigquery.

config.label: Path to BigQuery service-account JSON
config.description: Path to BigQuery service-account JSON. Omit on GKE / Cloud Run with workload identity.

config.label: Set to 'on' to enable role-aware PII masking on result rows (emails, SSNs, phones, IPs, Luhn-validated CCs)
config.description: Set to 'on' to enable role-aware PII masking on result rows (emails, SSNs, phones, IPs, Luhn-validated CCs). Off by default.

config.label: Per-principal token-bucket rate limit on tool invocations
config.description: Per-principal token-bucket rate limit on tool invocations. 0 = disabled. Recommend 60 for production.
